The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled:  (A) outside of ice machine (food splash), (B) outside of convection (toaster) oven.  Clean these non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.comment: Sand/paint/repair the rub rail by the back door.  700-1210.  Seal/repair the open hatch to the CO2 tank across from the ice machine.  700-1210.  See the 7/20/12 routine inspection for details.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: Found can of cheese sauce with dent along top seam.  750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.  Can set to the side to be returned for credit.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Observed frozen chicken strips stored directly above bread in large chest freezer.  750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED.  Bread was removed from under chicken and chest freezer was sorted appropriately.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: The following surfaces were soiled:  (A) box fan (REPEAT)  (B)  utensil bucket on wire shelves  (C) convection oven.  750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.  Clean these surfaces.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed cleaned cutting boards stored upright with direct contact with the floor next to wire shelves.  750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.  Clean and sanitize cutting boards and store properly.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: Observed approximately 3 inch gap along bottom of service door.  750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.  Repair door sweep.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the following floors to be soiled:  (A) back corner by wire shelves  (B) under ice machine  (C) wire shelves in computer area  (D) under convection oven cart.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.  Observed the floor drain in the wall for the soda machine is soiled (REPEAT).  750-1220  Clean the drain.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the wall behind chest freezer to be soiled.  750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.   
Observed rub rail near back door to be chipped/in disrepair.  750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
Observed access hatch to soda machine CO2 tank area to be unattached and not properly sealed.  750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide smooth, durable, and tight fitting hatch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Rust was observed on the glass cooler cooling unit and some condensation was dripping.  Remove the rust.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the wire shelving is damaged.  Repair the floor. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
The floor drain in the wall for the soda machine is soiled.  Clean the drain.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The wall board behind the steamers is pulling away from the wall.  Repair the wall board.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
The light shield near the 3 compartment sink is broken.  Replace the light shield.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: The concentration of Chlorine in the sanitizing bucket was well above 200 ppm.  The bucket was emptied and the new concentration was approximately 100 ppm. 750-820 Chemicals used for sanitizing shall not have concentrations higher than the maximum.
